title: Make your own brushes: a Custom group, a brush file, a brush from a selection
goal: The brush library mock has a Custom group where brushes you make land: start a new brush, import a brush file, or make one from a selection, and delete only custom ones. Today the library shows only the eight built in brushes and no Custom chip.
notes: Left out of brushes-are-picked-from-a-library-of-tiles-that on purpose (its notes: the Custom group, importing and making a brush from a selection are not part of it). BrushLibrary (PhotonzCore/BrushLibrary.swift) lists BrushMedium.allCases by BrushGroup; a custom brush is a saved BrushSettings preset with a name, so BrushLibrary needs a preset list beside the media and BrushGroup a .custom case. Tiles already render any BrushSettings (BrushPreview, BrushPreviewCache). Needs brush-editor.html for what New brush opens.
acceptance: The Library's Brushes shelf and the chooser over the tool bar show a Custom chip, and a brush you make appears there as a tile showing its own stroke
The Library's plus offers New brush, Import a brush file and Make brush from selection, as brush-library.html draws them
Only a custom brush can be deleted, from its right-click menu and the panel
